- RBAC basics: Role, RoleBinding, service accounts
- Namespace scoping vs ClusterRoles

- testing permissions with kubectl can-i

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: dev-read
  namespace: dev
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: pod-reader
  namespace: dev
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods"]
  verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: dev-read-binding
  namespace: dev
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: dev-read
  namespace: dev
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: pod-reader
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```
